nodes.text: Pot's warm, love. What do you need?

choices.text: What else can a fire do?

nodes.text: Anything you catch, a fire makes better — chicken, beef, the brook's fish once you've the patience for a rod. Any village fire will serve a traveller, and out in the wild you'll learn to build your own. It's the same knack everywhere.
South of the bridge, along the near bank — berries, fibre, sageroot. Take a full pocket. The bank never minds.
Go on then — once. {item:cooked_chicken} — careful, it's hot. After this you cook your own. That's not me being hard, love. That's me making sure you can.
Warm hands, dry boots. Go on now.
